entry.title: Ilédì Oǹtótóo, Second Palace

terrainReference.basis: Native terrain at the approximate center of the published aerial scan area.

entry.note: The draft centers on the published scan coverage and faces approximately south, 173.7° true, following the best exterior panorama fit. The panorama pin differs from the archive center by about 167 m, and the interior panorama supports a different direction. The model envelope clears the mapped road and river at this trial position. The actual footprint, ground datum and bearing remain unresolved.

entry.title: Ilédì Oǹtótóo, Second Palace

terrainReference.basis: Sampled map terrain at the draft anchor. The real porch datum still awaits field placement confirmation.

entry.note: The georeferenced nomination marker defines a search center. The trial forecourt faces the PMTiles road to the east, supported only by the documented street approach. The site and direct approach remain obscured.

archiveLocationTrial.notes: The aerial scan bounds center 63 m northeast of the registered draft. The roof cannot be traced through adjoining canopy and shadows. With the draft bearing retained, raw terrain is 0.81 m above the model floor at the right-side probe. A signed roof axis and a measured foundation profile remain open.
archiveLocationTrial.basis: The bounds are publisher-supplied approximate rectangles. The data is cataloged without geographic registration. This trial uses the aerial bounds center and the existing provisional bearing.

eastFacingDraft.title: Ilédì Oǹtótóo, Second Palace

terrainReference.basis: Native terrain at the approximate center of the published aerial scan area.

eastFacingDraft.note: The draft anchor uses the published scan coverage, 63 m from the earlier nomination-map trial and 17 m from the gridded Iledi symbol. Both signed forecourt trials clear the mapped road and river. The trees obscure the occupied footprint. The archive rectangles describe approximate coverage, and the east-facing bearing and dimensions remain provisional.

mapFit.result: Both oppositely signed orientations clear mapped features. The scan rectangles and the plotted Iledi symbol support the archive search area without establishing a footprint or the direction of the forecourt.

sightline.interpretation: Camera-to-grille ray from the indoor view. Its easterly sightline supports investigating the east-facing trial. The viewing ray alone does not determine the forecourt axis. The station coordinates disagree with the scan coverage.

photos.observation: The projecting upper figure has a separate head and two extended arms. A lower reddish trunk and two pale tusks curve out below it.
The profile photograph shows the carved mass in front of the right gable. The tusks and upper figure emerge above the low sculpture in the forecourt.

elephantWing.interpretation: The master and three nearer tiers model the projecting figure, long arms, trunk and paired tusks. Dimensions, depth, and the hidden attachment to the gable relief are interpreted from the photographs.

fieldSurveyComparison.finding: The published field-survey point supports the general vicinity of the archive scan but lies 20.84 m from the draft anchor. The differing sculpture control points show that the table cannot independently register a footprint or bearing at this scale.

exteriorPanorama.interpretation: On the panorama compass the left and middle roofs lie from north-northwest toward east-northeast. Their roof run and the photographed forecourt support a southerly direction. Earlier trials faced east and west.
exteriorPanorama.sensitivityBasis: Ray-to-roof-height estimate from two manually picked ridge tips. Varies reconstructed ridge heights, assumed camera height and effective field of view. The range describes the test parameters, with camera north registration and actual roof dimensions uncertain.
exteriorPanorama.sculpture: The upturned forearms converge on two stacked closed fists with weathered finger bands. The closely spaced hollow arms stand out in front of the left-gable relief.
